classification.difficultyReason: Form the winning-ticket fraction and use its complement for not winning.

content.prompt:
Levon buys 5 tickets in a raffle of 1000 tickets.
What is the probability that he doesn’t win?

answer.worked:
Assuming one winning ticket is selected and all tickets are equally likely to win:
$$\begin{align*}P(\text{not win})&=1-\frac{5}{1000}\\P(\text{not win})&=\frac{995}{1000}\\P(\text{not win})&=\frac{199}{200}\end{align*}$$
